model_normalization.rule: strip date suffix and [1m]; retain every other raw model id

meter.note: This meter counts the whole account -- web, phone and every other machine -- while only this host's transcripts are read, so every stretch may carry usage the tokens cannot see. Read `capture` and `capture_status` per stretch before using a rate; the capture check is advisory here (CAPTURE_GATE is False) and never withholds a stretch from this file.
